h1_report_path_collision_fix.note: Only the CICIDS config report_md was changed. The UNSW config and the existing UNSW report file were not touched, moved, deleted, or archived.

h2_dataset_aware_output_fix.mechanism: Added _dataset_report_metadata(config) helper returning dataset-aware title/status/protocol/scope/safety wording. _build_test_metrics_payload, _build_manifest, and _write_report now use it. UNSW branch keeps the exact prior UNSW-NB15/A8.8 wording; CICIDS branch emits CICIDS2018 wording with no UNSW/A8.8 mention; a generic fallback covers any future dataset. Rare-class report header now derives names from the rare_class bundle instead of hardcoded 'Shellcode, Worms'.
fixed_locations: _write_report: title, status, scope bullets, 'not started yet' line, rare-class header, safety-confirmation bullets

m1_float64_memory_micro_fix.reason: Small and safe: _validate_split_labels previously ran np.isfinite(np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)) which upcast the whole feature array to float64 (~4 GB transient for CICIDS ~6.7M x 77). Now uses np.asarray(X) and only scans np.isfinite for floating dtypes (integer/bool arrays are inherently finite). Finite-validation behavior is preserved (NaN/Inf still flagged for float features); no float64 upcast.

out_of_scope_left_unchanged.a8_8_unsw_precondition_gate: validate_execute_preconditions still requires docs/UNSW_SPLIT_PROTOCOL_DECISION.md + pre_training_high_findings_resolution.json (ready_for_unsw_training=true). It currently PASSES for CICIDS because those A8.8 files exist. This is a latent cross-dataset coupling, NOT one of the approved H1/H2/M1 fixes, and changing a safety gate was out of scope, so it was intentionally left untouched and is recorded as a follow-up item.
out_of_scope_left_unchanged.module_comments: Module docstring/comments still mention 'UNSW-NB15 first' / 'UNSW fits in RAM' (internal comments only, not emitted artifacts).

tests_added_or_updated: tests/test_cicids_pretraining_safe_fixes.py (new): H1 report-path assertions; H2 dataset-aware payload/manifest/report text (CICIDS has no UNSW/A8.8, UNSW keeps its wording); M1 float32-safe finite check (NaN/Inf flagged, integer features handled).
remaining_risks: The A8.8/UNSW precondition gate is still applied to CICIDS (passes only because the A8.8 files exist). Recommend generalizing it in a future approved task; not changed here to avoid weakening a safety check.
Tests were not executed by the agent; the user must run the manual pytest command to confirm green before any training.
Module-level docstring/comments still reference UNSW; cosmetic only (not part of any emitted report/metrics/manifest).
